title: Woodfiring Extravaganza! Firing Workshop at Mendocino Art Center
source_quote: Woodfiring Extravaganza! Firing Workshop; August 15 to 17 In this hands-on firing workshop, students will get the chance to load and fire both the wood-fired train kiln and the wood-fired soda kiln.
evidence_sentence: Students load and fire the wood-fired train kiln over a 48-hour cycle with required stoking shifts.
evidence_quote: students will get the chance to load and fire both the wood-fired train kiln and the wood-fired soda kiln. Students will learn stacking strategies to account for flame flow and ash accumulation. Students will also be required to take stoking shifts throughout the 48 hour cycle.
summary: A hands-on wood firing workshop at Mendocino Arts Center (Mendocino, California) from August 15-17, 2026, loading and firing the wood-fired train kiln with required stoking shifts throughout the 48-hour cycle.
commitment: August 15-17 (48 hour cycle with stoking shifts)
